_fixture.source: Worked out by hand from double-a.csv and double-b.csv (made-up data, ข้อมูลสมมุติ): the same eight paper forms typed by two people, key column 'รหัสโค'. OWNER: data role (M2-DESIGN.md 4.6).
_fixture.note: C006 is typed twice in file 1, so it is listed and not compared. C007 is only in file 2. C๐๐๘ in file 2 matches C008 (keys are read with Thai digits as Arabic digits). ' ลบ ' in file 2 equals 'ลบ' after trimming. '398' against '398.0' is a difference: cells are compared as text, never as numbers.
